name: Hungary
tagline: Medicine in English — but you pay for all of it yourself
summary: Hungary is where Scandinavians go to study medicine in English, and the five medical schools are genuinely open to you. What you need to understand before anything else is the money. Hungary's big scholarships — Stipendium Hungaricum and the Diaspora Scholarship — are both closed to EU citizens, and Denmark is not on the list for Hungary's bilateral state scholarships either. As a Danish student you are self-funded, and a medical degree costs roughly 15,000 to 19,000 euros a year for six years. The one piece of good news: Szeged waives its medicine entrance exam entirely if your IB has a 5 in two Higher Level sciences.
whyConsider: Five medical schools teach medicine, dentistry and pharmacy fully in English, with entrance exams you can sit online from Denmark.

Szeged waives the entrance exam outright for an IB Diploma with grade 5 in two Higher Level natural sciences — the best IB-specific deal in Hungary, and it will consider predicted grades for a conditional offer.
The Hungarian érettségi equivalence of the IB Diploma is established in law, so no case-by-case recognition application is needed.
Living costs outside Budapest are very low. A dormitory place costs HUF 13,000 a month in Szeged and HUF 18,000 in Debrecen, against HUF 225,000 for a private Budapest flat.
As an EU student you have unlimited work rights once you hold a registration card, and your Danish EHIC gives you healthcare on the same terms as a Hungarian.
watchOuts: Stipendium Hungaricum is closed to you. It works through bilateral sending-partner agreements and no EU member state is on the list. The Diaspora Scholarship excludes anyone resident inside the EU. Hungary's bilateral state scholarships list 30 countries and Denmark is not one of them. You are self-funded.

Medical tuition is the real cost: Semmelweis charges 9,340 euros a semester for medicine and dentistry, Debrecen 16,900 US dollars a year, Szeged 15,800 euros, Pécs 16,750 dollars. Add application, exam, deposit and registration fees of several hundred to two thousand more.

CEU's bachelor's degrees are in Vienna, not Budapest. After the 2017 law change CEU moved its degree teaching to Austria in September 2019. Budapest keeps the Democracy Institute, the Institute for Advanced Study and the archives, but grants no bachelor's degrees.

Semmelweis does not name the IB Diploma anywhere in its entry requirements and offers no exam exemption. It asks only for a school-leaving certificate from an accredited school. Confirm your position with them directly.
Most 2027 deadlines were not published when this was researched. Only Semmelweis has a firm date (31 May 2027) and only Pécs has firm 2027 exam dates.
No Scandinavian entrance-exam centre was confirmed anywhere. The online and Zoom formats at Szeged, Semmelweis and Univet are your practical route.

ibRecognition.subjectLevelRule: IB subjects are mapped onto Hungarian érettségi subjects — Business Management to üzleti ismeretek, Economics to gazdasági ismeretek, and so on. To claim érettségi points you need at least two acceptable or matchable subjects at the required level. Higher Level counts at full value; Standard Level is multiplied by two thirds.
ibRecognition.gradeConversion: Hungarian legislation establishes that the IB Diploma is equivalent to the Hungarian érettségi, so no separate recognition application is needed. The Educational Authority (Oktatási Hivatal) converts grades to points: a 7 counts as 100 percent and scores 100 points at Higher Level or 67 at Standard; a 6 is 88 percent, 88 or 59 points; a 5 is 76 percent, 76 or 51; a 4 is 63 percent, 63 or 42; a 3 is 51 percent, 51 or 34; a 2 is 39 percent, 39 or 26.
notes: Only the full IB Diploma counts as a school-leaving certificate. If you are graduating in the admission year you may instead submit an authenticated Results Summary or Candidate Results showing 'Diploma awarded' — a school-stamped printout from the electronic system is accepted. Individual Certificate or Course Results documents are not, and provisional results are rejected.
There is an exception: if you hold another school-leaving certificate and took DP exams without earning the Diploma, points can still be calculated per subject from the Course Results.
The whole points-conversion machinery applies to the central Hungarian-language admission procedure. The English-taught medical programmes bypass it entirely and use their own entrance exams instead.

Szeged is the only medical school with a verified IB exemption: grade 5 in two Higher Level natural sciences from Biology, Chemistry or Physics exempts you from the entrance exam, plus English if your language of instruction was not English. Predicted grades may support a conditional offer.

Corvinus is the most IB-literate institution in Hungary. It names the IB Diploma explicitly as an accepted credential, accepts IB English at SL 5 or HL 4 as English proof, and accepts IB Maths at SL 5 or HL 4 in place of its own maths entrance exam.
CEU accepts IB English at 5 or above, at either level, as exemption from English testing, and for its Data Science degree accepts IB Maths HL 5 or SL 6 as proof of mathematical competency.
Debrecen, Semmelweis and the veterinary university offer no IB-based exam exemption. No Hungarian institution publishes a minimum IB point score.
The maximum total admission points in the Hungarian system and the minimum score for medicine could not be verified.

portal.name: For English-taught programmes you apply directly to each university, each with its own portal. The central felvi.hu / E-felvételi system covers Hungarian-language and state-funded places only.

deadlines.label: CEU (Vienna) bachelor's — round 1 of four
deadlines.notes: All at 23:59 CET. CEU's own financial aid is awarded in the first two rounds only, so apply early if you want it. Accepted students pay a 500-euro registration fee.

deadlines.label: University of Veterinary Medicine Budapest — rolling application window
deadlines.notes: Published as "1 January - 30 June" with no year; the year here is inferred from the standing rule. Later rounds are possible if places remain. Exams are arranged worldwide and online between March and July, with extra rounds in August if there are vacancies.

deadlines.label: CEU (Vienna) bachelor's — round 2 of four
deadlines.notes: All at 23:59 CET. CEU's own financial aid is awarded in the first two rounds only, so apply early if you want it. Accepted students pay a 500-euro registration fee.

deadlines.label: University of Pécs — entrance exams for the 2027 intake
deadlines.notes: Published as "every Wednesday, 3 March - 14 July": the window runs weekly, not continuously. Register two weeks in advance. Exams can be sat in Pécs, in Budapest at McDaniel College, or abroad through representative agencies. The 2027 application deadline itself was not published.

deadlines.label: CEU (Vienna) bachelor's — round 3 of four
deadlines.notes: All at 23:59 CET. CEU's own financial aid is awarded in the first two rounds only, so apply early if you want it. Accepted students pay a 500-euro registration fee.

deadlines.label: Semmelweis University — application deadline for autumn 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Stated on all three programme pages, so this is a genuine 2027 date. Applications run through the SEMAPHOR system. Entrance exams are held once or twice a week from early March until the end of June.

deadlines.label: CEU (Vienna) bachelor's — round 4 of four
deadlines.notes: All at 23:59 CET. CEU's own financial aid is awarded in the first two rounds only, so apply early if you want it. Accepted students pay a 500-euro registration fee.

deadlines.label: Corvinus — English certificate deadline
deadlines.notes: Published as "1 August" with no year; the year here is inferred from the intake this profile covers. Corvinus applies through DreamApply, runs assessment exams monthly and returns results in two to three weeks. Application fee 95 euros.

deadlines.label: University of Debrecen — application deadline
deadlines.notes: Not published as of September 2026. For 2026 entry the September intake closed 15 June and the February intake 1 November. Expect something similar and check from late 2026.

deadlines.label: University of Szeged — application deadline
deadlines.notes: Not published as of September 2026; the portal showed the 2026/27 period as closed. Exams ran end of February to end of June every second week for the 2026/27 intake.

steps: Work out the funding first. There is no Hungarian scholarship open to a Danish citizen, so budget the full tuition plus living costs before you commit to anything.
If you want medicine, decide early whether to target Szeged. Its IB exam exemption is worth a great deal of effort — grade 5 in two HL sciences and you skip the entrance exam altogether.

Apply directly to each university through its own portal: SEMAPHOR at Semmelweis, DreamApply at Szeged and Corvinus, apply.univet.hu at the veterinary university, and their own systems at Debrecen and Pécs.
Pay the application fee, which varies enormously: 95 euros at Corvinus, 150 dollars at Debrecen, 200 dollars at Pécs, 200 euros at Univet, 300 euros at Szeged, 400 dollars at Semmelweis.

Book your entrance exam. At the medical schools these run roughly March to July and are taken online — Szeged on Coospace monitored by Zoom, Semmelweis on Moodle, Pécs and Univet with an oral interview over Zoom or Teams.
Pay the tuition deposit to hold your place. It is usually deducted from your first semester fee: 2,000 dollars at Semmelweis, 800 euros at Szeged and at Univet.

After you arrive, register with the National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing within 93 days of entry. The registration certificate costs HUF 1,000 and never expires — and it is what unlocks unlimited work rights.
application.selectionNotes: The English-taught medical programmes select on their own entrance exam, not on your IB points. The pattern is a written multiple-choice paper in biology and chemistry (or physics) plus English, followed by an oral interview over Zoom on motivation and subject knowledge. Debrecen can also place you in a preparatory Basic Medicine Course rather than admitting or rejecting outright. Szeged caps English-programme intake at around 200 students a year and Pécs at 180. At Corvinus, maths is either evidenced by your IB grade or tested in a 26-question online exam, and three programmes add an interview.

language.englishTaughtBachelors: Substantial in medicine and business, thinner elsewhere. Five universities teach medicine, dentistry and pharmacy in English; Corvinus has 8 English-taught bachelor's degrees in business, economics and social sciences; the veterinary university teaches its whole degree in English. Counts for BME, ELTE, Óbuda, MOME, the Liszt Academy, Budapest Metropolitan and Széchenyi István could not be verified.
language.englishProof: Set institution by institution, and generally easy for an IB student. Corvinus accepts IB English at SL 5 or HL 4, or IELTS 6.0. CEU accepts IB English at 5 or above at either level, or IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 88. Debrecen requires a proctored B2 certificate but exempts anyone who completed secondary education in English — which covers an IB school. At Semmelweis, Szeged, Pécs and Univet, English is assessed inside the entrance exam itself, so no external certificate is usually needed.
notes: Hungarian-language state-funded places exist but are not a realistic route. Whether an EU citizen is legally eligible could not be verified, and the obligations are severe: you must graduate within one and a half times the standard study period and then work in Hungary for a period equal to the scholarship duration within a twenty-year window, or repay the whole thing.
No evidence was found that state-funded places exist on English-taught programmes at all.
Semmelweis publishes no certificate score, asking only for 'upper intermediate' English tested through its General English and Biomedical English papers.

tuitionEuEea.value: No EU discount exists — you pay the same published fees as everyone else. Medicine: Semmelweis 9,340 euros per semester (18,680 a year), Szeged 7,900 per semester (15,800 a year), Debrecen 16,900 US dollars a year, Pécs 16,750 dollars a year. Dentistry: Semmelweis 9,340 euros per semester, Debrecen 17,500 dollars, Pécs 17,350 dollars. Pharmacy: Semmelweis 5,820 euros per semester, Debrecen 8,000 dollars, Pécs 8,400 euros. Veterinary medicine at Univet Budapest 12,480 euros a year. Corvinus bills EEA applicants in forints: HUF 1,700,000 to 1,980,000 a year.
tuitionEuEea.year: Semmelweis 2027 entry, Pécs 2027/28, Szeged and Debrecen and Univet 2026/27, Corvinus year not stated

tuitionNonEu.value: Broadly the same, with one exception. The medical schools publish a single fee per programme with no nationality split. Corvinus does distinguish: it bills non-EEA applicants in euros at 6,000 to 6,600 a year and EEA applicants in forints at HUF 1,700,000 to 1,980,000, so the difference is the currency and the exchange-rate risk rather than the headline price.

costs.applicationFee: Varies a lot: 95 euros at Corvinus, 150 US dollars at Debrecen plus a 350-dollar exam fee, 200 dollars at Pécs plus 250 for the exam and 220 registration, 200 euros at Univet plus 250 for the exam and 220 registration, 300 euros at Szeged, 400 US dollars at Semmelweis plus a 2,000-dollar deposit and 230 enrolment fee. CEU charges accepted students a 500-euro registration fee.

livingCostMonthly.value: Dormitory places run from HUF 13,000 a month in Szeged and 18,000 in Debrecen up to HUF 36,000 in Budapest and 40,000 in Győr. A shared flat with utilities costs around HUF 80,000 outside Budapest and 140,000 in the capital; a private flat 135,000 to 175,000 outside Budapest and 225,000 in it. A restaurant meal is HUF 2,500 to 4,000 and a single transport ticket 350 to 650.
livingCostMonthly.year: not stated on the source page

notes: Study in Hungary publishes no all-in monthly total and no euro figures, and does not say which year its price data is from. At roughly 400 forints to the euro, a Szeged dormitory is about 33 euros a month and a Budapest private flat about 560 — but that arithmetic is not from the source and is sensitive to the exchange rate.

Two official pages disagree about private rents. The accommodation page gives HUF 120,000 to 220,000 in Budapest plus overheads and 70,000 to 180,000 outside it; the cost-of-living page gives higher figures including utilities.
Landlords usually want a deposit of at least two months' rent up front.

Szeged offers three discounts worth 300 euros each: an early-bird if you are admitted by 30 April, a sibling discount, and an alumni discount if a parent graduated there. Corvinus offers 10 percent off first-year tuition for early admission with payment by 31 March.
The regional medical cities are dramatically cheaper than Budapest on housing, which partly offsets Semmelweis's higher tuition.

funding: Danish SU for a full degree abroad, at DKK 7,426 a month before tax for students living away from home in 2026. Hungary is not a Nordic country for SU purposes, so support is capped at four years — which does not cover a six-year medical degree. Plan for that gap.

Stipendium Hungaricum is closed to you. It operates through bilateral sending-partner agreements and requires nomination by your country's designated authority. No EU member state appears on the partner list — the only European entries are non-EU countries in the Western Balkans plus Moldova, Ukraine, Belarus, Russia, Georgia, Armenia and Türkiye.

The Hungarian Diaspora Scholarship is also closed to you. It is open only to members of the Hungarian diaspora residing outside the European Union, so Hungarian ancestry does not help if you live in Denmark.

Hungary's bilateral state scholarships, administered by the Tempus Public Foundation, list about thirty eligible countries for full-degree study. Denmark appears in none of them. This is a specific and unusual gap — Norway, Sweden, Finland and Iceland are all on the list and Denmark is not.

What is left are institutional discounts, and they are small. Szeged offers 300 euros off per semester for siblings and children of alumni, and 300 off the first semester for early admission. Corvinus offers 10 percent off first-year tuition for early admission and 30 percent for holders of a Corvinus degree. CEU awards its own financial aid, but only to applicants in the first two of its four rounds, and the amounts could not be verified.
A realistic conclusion: a Danish IB student in Hungary is self-funded, with Danish SU as the only meaningful support.
workRights: EU and EEA students have no limit on working hours, provided you hold a registration card. That makes registering within 93 days more than a formality. Non-EU students are capped at 30 hours a week during term and 90 days or 66 working days outside it. Study in Hungary puts unskilled student work at roughly 445 euros net a month for eight-hour days and skilled work at about 550.
residency: As an EU citizen you may stay beyond three months if you are enrolled at an accredited institution, and you must register with the National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing within 93 days of entering the country. Bring your admission certificate, your passport or ID card, proof of sufficient funds and evidence of health insurance. The fee is HUF 1,000, payable by card or transfer, and you can file at a regional directorate or electronically through the Enter Hungary platform. The registration certificate is issued immediately and has no expiry date.
housing: Dormitories, called kollégium, are the cheap option and the gap between cities is enormous: HUF 13,000 a month in Szeged against HUF 36,000 in Budapest and 40,000 in Győr. Whether international fee-paying students can actually get dormitory places could not be verified, and no university-specific dormitory prices were confirmed — so treat the national figures as indicative and ask your university directly. Private rentals in Budapest run HUF 120,000 to 225,000 a month depending on which official page you read, with a deposit of at least two months' rent.
healthcare: Bring your Danish EHIC. As an EU citizen you are covered on the same terms as a Hungarian, with the same rights and obligations. Students on exchange or at a state-run institute get free medical care; students who do not meet those criteria can sign an agreement with the Hungarian Health Insurance Fund at a cost of 30 percent of the local minimum wage. Note that the EHIC covers medically necessary state-provided care, not comprehensive private cover. Whether an EU student needs a Hungarian TAJ social security card alongside the EHIC could not be verified — the official healthcare page does not mention it at all.

institutions.name: Semmelweis University
institutions.englishBachelors: General Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences and Nursing, all taught in English. A full count of English-taught programmes was not published.
institutions.note: Hungary's flagship medical university and the single biggest draw for Scandinavian medical applicants, with around 16,000 students and teaching in Hungarian, English and German. It is also the most expensive: 9,340 euros a semester for medicine or dentistry. It has already published its 2027 deadline of 31 May, but it does not name the IB anywhere in its entry requirements and offers no exam exemption — confirm your position with them before applying.

institutions.name: University of Szeged
institutions.englishBachelors: General Medicine (MD), 12 semesters and 360 ECTS with around 200 students a year, plus a Foundation Year. Dentistry and pharmacy fees sit with separate faculties and could not be verified.
institutions.note: The one Hungarian medical school that will waive the entrance exam outright for a strong IB Diploma: grade 5 in two Higher Level sciences from biology, chemistry or physics, and you are exempt. It will also consider predicted grades for a conditional offer. Szeged also has the cheapest dormitories in the country at HUF 13,000 a month. The 2027 deadline had not been published.

institutions.name: University of Debrecen
institutions.englishBachelors: Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Nursing, Physiotherapy, Computer Science, engineering and science bachelor's degrees, priced in US dollars from 6,500 to 17,500 a year
institutions.note: Hungary's largest English-language medical intake outside Budapest, across thirteen faculties, and one of the cheapest big cities to live in — dormitories at HUF 18,000 a month. Its entrance exam covers biology plus chemistry or physics, written and oral. It offers no IB exemption, and its exam dates and venues could not be read.

institutions.name: University of Pécs
institutions.englishBachelors: General Medicine (180 places), Dentistry, Pharmacy and Biotechnology BSc, with fees published for 2027/28
institutions.note: Hungary's oldest university by founding date and the only medical school with 2027-entry exam dates already published — every Wednesday from 3 March to 14 July 2027. Its fee page is also labelled 2027/28, which makes it the best-dated source in the country. You can sit the exam in Pécs, in Budapest, or abroad through a representative agency. Its 2027 application deadline and its position on the IB were not published.

institutions.name: University of Veterinary Medicine Budapest
institutions.englishBachelors: Veterinary medicine in English, five years plus an eleventh practical semester, at 12,480 euros a year. Also biology at BSc and MSc level.
institutions.note: One of Europe's oldest veterinary schools and the cheapest English-taught clinical programme reviewed here. Applications are rolling from 1 January to 30 June each year, and exams run worldwide and online from March to July. There is no IB exemption — the oral exam is mandatory for everyone, and you need at least 50 percent on the written paper to reach it.

institutions.name: Corvinus University of Budapest
institutions.englishBachelors: 8 — Applied Economics, Business and Management, Business Informatics, Communication and Media Science, Data Science in Business, International Business, International Relations, and Philosophy Politics and Economics
institutions.note: The most IB-literate admissions policy in Hungary: the IB Diploma is named explicitly, IB English at SL 5 or HL 4 covers the language requirement, and IB Maths at SL 5 or HL 4 replaces the maths entrance exam. It has been run by a private foundation since 2019 rather than directly by the state. Note that it bills EEA applicants in forints, so you carry the exchange-rate risk.

institutions.name: Central European University
institutions.englishBachelors: 3, all taught in Vienna — Culture Politics and Society; Data Science and Society; Philosophy, Politics and Economics. You can take a three-year Austrian-accredited or four-year dual US and Austrian route.
institutions.note: Read this carefully: there is no CEU bachelor's degree in Budapest. After Hungary's 2017 law change CEU moved its degree teaching to Vienna, completing in September 2019. Budapest keeps the Democracy Institute, the Institute for Advanced Study and the Blinken Open Society Archives, none of which grant degrees. If you apply to CEU you are applying to Austria. Its tuition could not be verified; only the 500-euro registration fee is confirmed.

institutions.name: Budapest University of Technology and Economics
institutions.note: Hungary's leading technical university, and often described as the world's oldest institute of technology with university rank. It is the obvious destination if you have HL Maths and Physics. Its admissions pages, English-taught bachelor count and fees could not be verified, so you will need to contact it directly.

institutions.name: Eötvös Loránd University
institutions.note: The oldest continuously operating university in Hungary and the broadest general-academic option in Budapest, with a second campus in Szombathely. Its English-taught bachelor count, admissions pages and fees could not be verified.

institutions.name: Óbuda University
institutions.note: A practically oriented applied-technology alternative to BME, with a second campus in Székesfehérvár outside the capital. Its John von Neumann informatics faculty is its best-known part. Whether it teaches bachelor's degrees in English could not be verified.

institutions.name: Franz Liszt Academy of Music
institutions.note: Founded by Liszt himself in 1875 and still Hungary's conservatoire, admitting by audition. It has an independent folk music faculty, which is unusual. Whether any bachelor's programme is taught in English could not be verified.

institutions.name: Moholy-Nagy University of Art and Design
institutions.note: Hungary's design school, in the Bauhaus lineage and named after László Moholy-Nagy. Strong in animation and media design. Whether it offers English-taught bachelor's degrees could not be verified.

institutions.name: Budapest Metropolitan University
institutions.note: Hungary's largest private university and the main English-taught option for creative-industries and tourism degrees. Its exact English-taught bachelor count and fees could not be verified.

institutions.name: Széchenyi István University
institutions.note: Built around the Audi plant in Győr, with an Audi Hungaria Faculty of Automotive Engineering — unusually direct industry links for an engineering student. Its English-taught provision and fees could not be verified.
